summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX announcement that the U.S. FDA granted Fast Track designation to its BiPASS program, which evaluates 68Ga-PSMA-PET imaging combined with MRI for pre-biopsy prostate cancer detection. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, or transaction dates were disclosed. The designation permits more frequent FDA engagement and potential expedited review of a planned NDA; Telix recently completed Phase 3 BiPASS enrollment and is preparing its submission. This is a routine regulatory/clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch NDA timing and any label expansion impact.
